name: BillHarbor (Dev)
short_desc: Development receipt acquisition and authenticated delivery control plane
author: EckPhi
description: Vendor-independent receipt and bill acquisition with immutable originals, local user sign-in and installable connector plugins. Development release; starts without vendors.

form_fields.label: Initial administrator username
form_fields.hint: Used only when no local users exist. Manage users in the app after first login.

form_fields.label: Initial administrator password
form_fields.hint: 15–1024 characters. Used only for first bootstrap; later changes belong in the app. See documentation for passwords containing dollar signs.

form_fields.label: Credential encryption key
form_fields.hint: Generated once. Back up with secrets and state; do not change after initialization.
